questions.question: What is the client/company name?
questions.answer: PURE FINANCIAL ADVISORS LLC

questions.question: What industry does the client operate in?
questions.answer: Financial advisory and wealth management

questions.question: What are the client's primary business offerings?
questions.answer: Financial advisory services and asset management

questions.question: What region/countries does the business operate in?
questions.answer: United States

questions.question: Who are the key business stakeholders?
questions.answer: Jason Carver (Client Engagement Manager), Lee Equity Partners (investment partner)

questions.question: What business model does the client follow?

questions.question: What is driving this initiative/project now?
questions.answer: Pure is looking to develop enhanced Lead-to-AUM (L2A) pipeline and customer acquisition cost (CAC) reporting to provide more granular information about the journey from lead to AUM and return on marketing spend.

questions.question: Which teams/processes are affected?
questions.answer: Data, technology, and marketing teams involved in pipeline and customer acquisition reporting.

questions.question: What systems/platforms are currently being used?
questions.answer: Salesforce, Tamarac, Azure Blob Storage, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, Power BI, and QuickBooks (to be integrated).

questions.question: What reporting or analytics tools exist today?
questions.answer: Power BI reporting suite.

questions.question: What databases/data sources are involved?
questions.answer: Salesforce, Tamarac, Azure Blob Storage, and QuickBooks.

questions.question: What manual processes currently exist?
questions.answer: Not mentioned in document.

questions.question: What integration challenges exist today?
questions.answer: Need to connect and ingest data from QuickBooks and assess data quality for CAC reporting.

questions.question: Are there performance/scalability issues?
questions.answer: Not mentioned in document.

questions.question: What are the primary data sources?
questions.answer: Salesforce, Tamarac, Azure Blob Storage, and QuickBooks.

questions.question: What cloud/platform infrastructure exists?
questions.answer: Microsoft Fabric and Azure Synapse data platforms.

questions.question: Are there data governance policies?
questions.answer: Not mentioned in document.

questions.question: What business problem is the client trying to solve?
questions.answer: To enhance and improve existing pipeline reporting and develop detailed Lead-to-AUM and Customer Acquisition Cost reporting.

questions.question: What are the current pain points?
questions.answer: Limited granularity in existing pipeline reporting and lack of integrated CAC insights.

questions.question: What inefficiencies exist in the current process?
questions.answer: Not mentioned in document.

questions.question: What capabilities/features are required?
questions.answer: Enhanced L2A and CAC data model, Power BI reporting suite, data ingestion from QuickBooks, and data quality assessment.

questions.question: What workflows should be automated?
questions.answer: Automated data ingestion and transformation pipelines for L2A and CAC reporting.

questions.question: What user roles/personas will use the system?
questions.answer: Data and technology stakeholders, senior leadership, and marketing teams.

questions.question: What security/compliance requirements exist?
questions.answer: Not mentioned in document.

questions.question: What integrations are mandatory?
questions.answer: Integration with QuickBooks and Salesforce.

questions.question: What should the future-state solution achieve?
questions.answer: Deliver a full Lead-to-AUM and CAC data model and reporting suite providing granular insights into pipeline performance and marketing ROI.

questions.question: What processes should become automated?
questions.answer: Data ingestion, transformation, and reporting refresh processes.

questions.question: What insights should leadership gain?
questions.answer: Granular understanding of the journey from lead to AUM and return on marketing spend.

questions.question: What user experience improvements are expected?
questions.answer: Improved Power BI dashboards with clear KPI definitions and visualizations.

questions.question: What business processes need improvement?
questions.answer: Pipeline reporting and customer acquisition cost tracking.

questions.question: What is the long-term vision for this solution?
questions.answer: To drive data maturity and scalable reporting capabilities for Pure’s growth.

questions.question: What scalability requirements exist?
questions.answer: The data platform and reporting should be scalable to support future data sources and reporting needs.

questions.question: What systems should the future platform integrate with?
questions.answer: Salesforce, QuickBooks, Tamarac, and Azure Fabric.

questions.question: What business decisions should AI support?
questions.answer: Not mentioned in document.

questions.question: What deliverables are expected from discovery?
questions.answer: KPI Book, Power BI mock-ups, Data Model design, Data Gap Assessment, Technical Approach, and Phase 3B Implementation Plan.

questions.question: Should the engagement include solution architecture?
questions.answer: Yes, the data model design and technical approach are part of the deliverables.

questions.question: Should wireframes/mockups be created?
questions.answer: Yes, Power BI mock-ups limited to 8 views will be created.

questions.question: Should a roadmap/phased plan be prepared?
questions.answer: Yes, a Phase 3B Implementation Plan will be prepared.

questions.question: Is a POC/MVP expected?
questions.answer: Not explicitly mentioned, but the Design phase outputs serve as a foundation for the Build phase.

questions.question: What level of technical detail is expected in the proposal?
questions.answer: Detailed data model, KPI logic, reporting requirements, and technical approach for QuickBooks integration.

questions.answer: Batch processing through automated pipelines in the Fabric data platform.

questions.question: Are APIs available for integrations?
questions.answer: Not mentioned in document.

questions.answer: 8-page Power BI report focused on L2A and CAC reporting.

questions.answer: Not mentioned in document.

questions.question: What alerts/notifications are required?
questions.answer: Not mentioned in document.

questions.question: What constraints, timelines, or dependencies must be considered?
questions.answer: Phase 3A is 3 weeks; Phase 3B is 8–12 weeks; dependent on QuickBooks ingestion and data quality assessment.

questions.question: What is in scope for this engagement?
questions.answer: Design and build of L2A and CAC data model, reporting suite, and QuickBooks integration.

questions.question: What is out of scope?
questions.answer: Connections to systems other than Salesforce and QuickBooks, existing report migrations, enhancements to previous reporting deliverables, and platform architecture changes.

questions.question: What are the expected business outcomes?
questions.answer: Enhanced L2A and CAC reporting providing actionable insights into pipeline performance and marketing ROI.

questions.question: What KPIs or success metrics matter most?
questions.answer: Lead-to-AUM conversion metrics and Customer Acquisition Cost KPIs.

questions.question: What risks exist if this problem is not solved?
questions.answer: Limited visibility into marketing effectiveness and pipeline performance.

questions.question: What does success look like for the client?
questions.answer: Accurate, automated, and insightful L2A and CAC reporting integrated into Power BI.

questions.question: What constraints exist?
questions.answer: Data access, data quality, and dependency on QuickBooks integration.

questions.question: Are there timeline expectations?
questions.answer: Phase 3A: 3 weeks; Phase 3B: 8–12 weeks.
